title: HMPSoC on FPGA (Heterogeneous Multi-Processor System on Chip)
description: Created a custom instruction set in Assembly, deployed on DE1-SoC Board using Quartus. Integrated memory, ALU, and control logic using VHDL, with C-based test programs. Validated CPU functionality using simulation and on-board debugging.

title: FPGA Pacemaker
description: Implemented a timing-critical dual-chamber pacemaker model using SCCharts. Developed ISR-driven logic in C for simulating atrial and ventricular events. Verified timing constraints and pacing through hardware simulation.

title: FPGA Game Console
description: Created a fully functional 'Flappy Bird' clone in VHDL on a DEO-CV FPGA board. Designed game logic, video output, and user input at hardware level. Achieved real-time gameplay with synced VGA display and collision mechanics.

title: STM32 MP3 Player
description: Multiple Protocols UART, SPI, GPIO, I2S, Display. Music Player, Timer, Alarm clock in USB sized device. Unit Testing and CI using GitHub Actions.

title: ATMega328P Shell
description: Fully functional shell made for reduce reflashing times & testing. Shell parser Usable on terminal. Created using Bare Metal C. UART, SPI, GPIO, PWM support.

title: Line-Following Robot
description: Designed and manufactured a PCB for motor and sensor integration. Programmed line-following control logic in embedded C for autonomous behaviour. Tuned motor performance across various track surfaces using real-world tests.

title: ASL Recognition AI
description: Developed an ASL alphabet recognition app with 95% model accuracy in 30 epochs. Built a PyQt5 GUI connected to three backend ML models including a custom CNN. Collaborated in a team of 3 to deliver the application.

title: MPAi Web App
description: Created a modern, interactive frontend using Vue.js and vanilla JS/CSS. Integrated a database of over 1,000 Steam games with dynamic data rendering. Collaborated on frontend/backend architecture and API connections.

title: Super Saturated Steam App
description: Designed and built an Android app using JavaScript and XML in Android Studio. Implemented interactive features for steam property calculations and education. Delivered within an 8-week project timeframe.

title: EVolocity Energy Resource Monitor
description: Developed a device to monitor voltage, current, and power from a standard power outlet. Displayed on a website using API integration, with offline support. Simulated analog circuitry in LTSpice and built a custom PCB.

title: Morra (Terminal App)
description: Core OOP principles applied: Inheritance, Polymorphism, Encapsulation. Solo university project focusing on terminal-based interaction.

title: Simulated Insurance System (Terminal App)
description: Core OOP principles applied: Inheritance, Polymorphism, Encapsulation. Solo university project.
